prompt.en: A school notice has important information. A student who cannot see it wants to read it by touch. Which version would help: a large-print sheet or a sheet with raised Braille dots?
prompt.hi: School notice mein zaroori jaankari hai. Ek student use dekh nahi sakta, par chhoo kar padhna chahta hai. Kya madad karega: bade aksharon wali sheet ya ubhre hue Braille dots wali sheet?

challenges.hint: Think about how touch can carry written information.

options.text: a sheet with raised Braille dots

challenges.keyText: a sheet with raised Braille dots

prompt.en: Two students are on a video call. One cannot hear, and neither can type during the call. Which method could they use to communicate: sign language, a voice note or a printed letter?
prompt.hi: Do students video call par hain. Ek sun nahi sakta, aur call ke dauraan dono type bhi nahi kar sakte. Woh baat karne ke liye kya use kar sakte hain: sign language, voice note ya printed letter?

challenges.hint: Look for a method that uses visible hand movements.

prompt.en: Meera must send a written invitation to her cousin in another town. Her cousin has no phone or internet, and the invitation can arrive next week. Which should Meera choose: a posted letter, a phone message or a hand gesture?
prompt.hi: Meera ko doosre shehar mein apne cousin ko likha hua invitation bhejna hai. Cousin ke paas phone ya internet nahi hai, aur invitation agle hafte tak pahunch sakta hai. Meera kya chune: daak se chitthi, phone message ya haath ka ishara?

challenges.hint: Distance and available technology matter more than speed here.

prompt.en: A neighbourhood map shows a post office, a bank, a hospital and a park. Which place is meant for both saving money and getting a loan: the bank or the post office?
prompt.hi: Mohalle ke map par post office, bank, hospital aur park hain. Paise jama karne aur loan lene, dono ke liye kaunsi jagah hai: bank ya post office?

challenges.hint: Think about where people keep savings and request loans.

prompt.en: On a map, north is at the top. The school is in the centre, the park directly east of it, and the market directly south. From the park, which direction is the market: south-west or north-west?
prompt.hi: Map mein uttar upar hai. School beech mein, park uske seedhe purab mein aur market seedhe dakshin mein hai. Park se market kis disha mein hai: dakshin-pashchim ya uttar-pashchim?

challenges.hint: Find the market's position relative to the park, not the school.

prompt.en: You want a cricket bat that costs ₹300. If you save ₹50 every week, how many weeks will it take?
prompt.hi: Tumhe ₹300 ka cricket bat chahiye. Agar har hafte ₹50 bachao, toh kitne hafte lagenge?

challenges.hint: Point to 50, 100, 150... and count the steps

prompt.en: You deposit five ₹100 notes in a bank. A month later you withdraw ₹500. Predict: will you get the same five notes back?
prompt.hi: Tumne bank mein ₹100 ke paanch note jama kiye. Ek mahine baad ₹500 nikaale. Guess karo: kya wahi paanch note wapas milenge?

challenges.hint: Point to the passbook line, which shows a number, not note serial numbers

prompt.en: Golu says: 'I have nine ₹1 coins and you have only two ₹5 coins, so I'm richer because I have more coins!' Check Golu.
prompt.hi: Golu kehta hai: 'Mere paas ₹1 ke nau sikke hain aur tumhare paas sirf ₹5 ke do. Mere paas zyada sikke hain, toh main ameer hoon!' Golu ko check karo.

challenges.hint: Point to 5 + 5

prompt.en: {friendF} has ₹40 saved for a ₹240 school fair pass. She saves ₹35 each week for six weeks. How much more than the pass price will she have?
prompt.hi: {friendF} ne ₹240 ke school fair pass ke liye ₹40 bachaye hain. Woh chhe hafton tak har hafte ₹35 bachati hai. Pass ki keemat se uske paas kitne rupaye zyada honge?

challenges.hint: Add the weekly savings to what she already has, then compare.

prompt.en: During a school nature walk, you notice a bird with a short, thick, cone-shaped beak. Which detail should you write in your observation record: its beak shape or the colour of the nearby wall?
prompt.hi: School nature walk mein tumhe ek pakshi ki chhoti, moti, cone jaisi chonch dikhti hai. Observation record mein kya likhoge: uski chonch ka aakaar ya paas ki deewar ka rang?

challenges.hint: Record a visible feature of the organism itself.

options.text: the colour of the nearby wall

prompt.en: A caterpillar eats a mango leaf. In a food chain, which arrow is correct: mango leaf → caterpillar or caterpillar → mango leaf?
prompt.hi: Ek illi aam ka patta khaati hai. Food chain mein kaunsa arrow sahi hai: aam ka patta → illi ya illi → aam ka patta?

challenges.hint: A food-chain arrow points from food towards its eater.

prompt.en: In a school pond, mosquito larvae eat algae, and small fish eat the larvae. Which chain is correct: algae → larvae → fish or fish → larvae → algae?
prompt.hi: School ke talab mein machhar ke larvae algae khaate hain, aur chhoti machhliyaan larvae khaati hain. Kaunsi chain sahi hai: algae → larvae → machhli ya machhli → larvae → algae?

challenges.hint: Follow the food as it passes to each eater.

prompt.en: A craft club weaves a basket from thin bamboo strips. Which part of the bamboo plant provides the strips: stem, root, or flower?
prompt.hi: Craft club bamboo ki patli pattiyon se tokri bunta hai. Ye pattiyan bamboo ke kis hissa se milti hain: tana, jad ya phool?

challenges.hint: The strips are cut from bamboo’s long, firm part.

prompt.en: For a school exhibition, you need plant materials for a shelter frame and a woven mat. Choose the correct pair in that order: bamboo and jute, or jute and bamboo?
prompt.hi: School exhibition ke liye shelter ka frame aur buni hui chatai banani hai. Isi kram mein sahi jodi chuno: bamboo aur jute, ya jute aur bamboo?

challenges.hint: Match sturdy poles to the frame and fibres to weaving.

prompt.en: Predict: if a child eats only rice and potatoes every day for months, with no dal, milk, fruits or vegetables, will they stay healthy? What might happen?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: agar koi bachcha mahino tak roz sirf chawal aur aloo khaaye, dal, doodh, phal ya sabzi bilkul nahi, toh kya woh healthy rahega? Kya ho sakta hai?

challenges.hint: Point to what body-building food does

prompt.en: Put a few grains of sugar on the side of your tongue, not the tip. Predict first: will you taste sweet there?
prompt.hi: Cheeni ke kuch daane zubaan ke side pe rakho, tip pe nahi. Pehle guess karo: kya wahan meetha lagega?

challenges.hint: Point to taste buds being all over the tongue

prompt.en: Shake a sealed packet of chips without opening it. Predict: is the packet full of chips? What fills the rest?
prompt.hi: Chips ka band packet bina khole hilao. Guess karo: kya packet chips se bhara hai? Baaki jagah mein kya hai?

challenges.hint: Point to the puffed-up shape

prompt.en: During a taste test, Kabir says only the tip of the tongue can taste sweet food. Is Kabir correct or incorrect? Give the key reason.
prompt.hi: Taste test mein Kabir kehta hai ki meetha sirf jeebh ki nok se mehsoos hota hai. Kabir sahi hai ya galat? Mukhya wajah batao.

challenges.hint: Think about whether tastes belong to separate tongue zones.

prompt.en: Meera sleeps from 9 pm to 7 am before a school trip. Does she get roughly enough sleep for a child her age? Answer yes or no.
prompt.hi: School trip se pehle Meera raat 9 baje se subah 7 baje tak soti hai. Kya usse apni umar ke hisaab se lagbhag poori neend milti hai? Haan ya nahin?

challenges.hint: Compare that time with the sleep children need.

prompt.en: Meera’s family has cut the ripe bajra crop. Before the grains can be stored, which comes first: threshing or winnowing?
prompt.hi: Meera ke ghar walon ne pakki bajra ki fasal kaat li hai. Daane store karne se pehle kya hoga: threshing ya winnowing?

challenges.hint: First separate grains from stalks; later remove lighter bits.

prompt.en: Two identical paper helicopters have the same wings. One has one paper clip at the bottom; the other has three. Dropped together, which will likely reach the floor first: one clip or three clips?
prompt.hi: Do ek jaise paper helicopters ke wings same hain. Ek ke neeche ek paper clip hai, doosre ke neeche 3. Saath chhodne par kaun pehle zameen par pahunchega: ek clip wala ya 3 clips wala?

challenges.hint: Consider how the added weight affects the fall.

prompt.en: A paper mill has leftover cotton cloth from a tailor. Can it use the cloth to make paper: yes or no?
prompt.hi: Paper mill ko tailor ke paas se bacha hua sooti kapda mila. Kya isse kaagaz ban sakta hai: haan ya nahin?

challenges.hint: Think about the fibres used to make paper.

prompt.en: For a school art project, wet paper pulp has been spread into a thin layer. What should you do next: press out water or dry it in the sun?
prompt.hi: School art project mein geela paper pulp patli parat mein phaila diya hai. Ab kya karoge: paani dabakar nikaaloge ya dhoop mein sukhaoge?

challenges.hint: Think about the step between spreading and drying.

prompt.en: A class spreads recycled-paper pulp and puts it straight in the sun without pressing. Compared with a pressed sheet, will it dry faster or slower?
prompt.hi: Class ne recycled-paper pulp phailaya aur bina dabaye seedha dhoop mein rakh diya. Dabayi hui sheet ke mukaable yeh jaldi sukhegi ya dheere?

challenges.hint: Pressing removes water before the sheet dries.

prompt.en: A school display uses an untreated bamboo stalk and a sheet of paper made from plant pulp. Which material is human-made: bamboo or paper?
prompt.hi: School display mein bina process kiya bamboo ka tana aur plant pulp se bana paper hai. Kaunsa material insaan ka banaya hua hai: bamboo ya paper?

challenges.hint: Think about what happens to plant pulp during making.

prompt.en: For a school model, Arjun picks a seashell from the beach and shapes a toy from melted wax. Which is the natural material: seashell or shaped wax?
prompt.hi: School model ke liye Arjun beach se seashell uthata hai aur pighle wax se toy banata hai. Kaunsa natural material hai: seashell ya shape diya hua wax?

challenges.hint: Judge the material by how much people changed it.

prompt.en: A cricket ground needs a new steel gate. Steel is made by processing a mineral dug from the earth. What natural source does the steel come from: iron ore or sand?
prompt.hi: Cricket ground ke liye naya steel gate chahiye. Steel zameen se nikle mineral ko process karke banta hai. Steel ka natural source kya hai: iron ore ya ret?

challenges.hint: Trace the finished material back to its mined source.

prompt.en: In the Thar desert it is very hot in the afternoon. Predict: will it also be hot at midnight?
prompt.hi: Thar registaan mein dopahar mein bahut garmi hoti hai. Guess karo: kya aadhi raat ko bhi utni hi garmi hogi?

challenges.hint: Ask what happens to sand after the sun goes down

prompt.en: On a map of India, a student marks a place south of the northern plains, beside the Arabian Sea. Which label fits better: Kerala coast or Ladakh?
prompt.hi: India ke map par student ne northern plains ke dakshin mein, Arabian Sea ke kinaare ek jagah mark ki. Kaunsa label zyada sahi hai: Kerala coast ya Ladakh?

challenges.hint: One option borders the sea; the other lies in northern mountains.

prompt.en: A school group sees houses in snowy Shimla. Which roof shape is more suitable there: steeply sloping or flat?
prompt.hi: Ek school group barf wale Shimla mein ghar dekhta hai. Wahan kaunsi chhat zyada theek rahegi: tez dhalan wali ya seedhi?

challenges.hint: Consider which shape lets snow slide off.

prompt.en: A village beside a river in Bihar has raised homes during the monsoon. Which description best matches these homes: houses on posts, houses with thick mud walls, or houses with flat roofs?
prompt.hi: Bihar mein nadi ke paas ek gaon mein monsoon ke liye ghar zameen se oonche banaye gaye hain. Kaunsa varnan sahi hai: khambhon par ghar, moti mitti ki deewaron wale ghar, ya seedhi chhat wale ghar?

challenges.hint: Look for the description with space beneath the floor.

prompt.en: During a school play, a spotlight shines from the left on a cardboard cutout. On which side of the cutout will its shadow fall: left or right?
prompt.hi: School play mein spotlight baayi taraf se cardboard cutout par pad rahi hai. Cutout ki parchhai kis taraf padegi: baayi ya daayi?

challenges.hint: The cutout blocks light from reaching the space beyond it.

prompt.en: At a sunny school assembly, Meera measures a flagpole’s shadow at 9 am and again at noon. Which measurement is likely shorter: 9 am or noon?
prompt.hi: Dhoop wali school assembly mein Meera flagpole ki parchhai 9 baje aur phir dopahar ko naapti hai. Kaunsi naap chhoti hogi: 9 baje ki ya dopahar ki?

challenges.hint: A higher Sun makes a shorter shadow.

prompt.en: At 7 am, sunlight enters a metro station from an east-facing doorway. A pillar stands just inside it. Which way will the pillar’s shadow point: east or west?
prompt.hi: Subah 7 baje metro station ke east-facing darwaaze se dhoop andar aa rahi hai. Darwaaze ke paas ek pillar hai. Uski parchhai east ya west kis taraf jayegi?

challenges.hint: A shadow points away from incoming sunlight.

prompt.en: A time-lapse video from a fixed camera shows the Sun appearing to move across the sky. What makes it appear to move: the Earth spinning or clouds pushing the Sun?
prompt.hi: Ek fixed camera ka time-lapse video dikhata hai ki Suraj aasman mein chalta hua lagta hai. Aisa kis wajah se lagta hai: Dharti ke ghoomne se ya badalon ke Suraj ko dhakelne se?

challenges.hint: Think about what the camera is standing on.

prompt.en: Tonight is Purnima. Predict: about one week from now, will the Moon look more lit, the same, or less lit?
prompt.hi: Aaj Purnima hai. Guess karo: lagbhag ek hafte baad chaand zyada roshan dikhega, waisa hi, ya kam?

challenges.hint: Point to the halfway point between Purnima and Amavasya

prompt.en: In a dark room, shine a torch on a white ball from one side. Walk slowly around the ball. Predict: will the lit part look the same from everywhere?
prompt.hi: Andhere kamre mein ek taraf se torch se safed ball pe roshni daalo. Ball ke chaaron taraf dheere-dheere ghoomo. Guess karo: kya roshan hissa har jagah se ek jaisa dikhega?

challenges.hint: Point to the torch staying in one place

prompt.en: A Moon calendar marks Purnima on day 1 and Amavasya around day 15. On day 22, is the visible lit part growing or shrinking? Think about where day 22 falls in the cycle.
prompt.hi: Moon calendar mein day 1 par Purnima aur lagbhag day 15 par Amavasya hai. Day 22 par chaand ka dikhta roshan hissa badh raha hoga ya ghat raha hoga? Cycle mein day 22 ki jagah socho.

challenges.hint: Use the Moon’s pattern after that marked day.
